questions.stem:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
The government has spent a lot of money on ______ the ancient citadel.
questions.explanation: Sau giới từ “on” và có tân ngữ “the ancient citadel” → dùng V-ing: restoring; “restoration” cần “of” (the restoration of).

questions.stem:

questions.stem:

Peer ______ can make teenagers do things they don't really want to do.
questions.explanation: “peer pressure” = áp lực từ bạn bè đồng trang lứa.

questions.stem:

questions.stem:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
Many young people suffer from ______ and stress because of study pressure.
questions.explanation: Sau “suffer from” cần danh từ, song song với “stress”: depression (trầm cảm).

questions.stem:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.
An ______ is a community of living things interacting with each other and with their environment.
questions.explanation: ecosystem = hệ sinh thái; ecology = sinh thái học (môn học), economy = nền kinh tế.

questions.stem:

The giant panda is an ______ species; fewer than 2,000 of them live in the wild.
questions.explanation: “endangered species” = loài có nguy cơ tuyệt chủng.

questions.stem:

Planting more trees helps ______ biodiversity in the area.
questions.explanation: help + (to) V nguyên mẫu → help maintain (giúp duy trì).

questions.stem:

questions.explanation: Đáp lại lời chúc mừng → cảm ơn: “Thank you. I'll try my best.”

questions.stem:
Choose the most suitable response to complete the exchange.
Lan: “Do you think we should ban mobile phones at school?”
Hoa: “______”
options: I'm not sure. Phones can be useful for learning.
questions.explanation: Câu hỏi xin ý kiến → nêu quan điểm và lí do.

questions.stem:
Choose the correct arrangement of the sentences to make a meaningful conversation.
a. Hoa: That's terrible. Have you told your teacher?
b. Hoa: You look upset, Lan. What's wrong?
c. Lan: Not yet. I'm afraid they will bully me even more.
d. Lan: Some classmates keep posting unkind comments about me online.
questions.explanation: Hoa hỏi chuyện (b) → Lan kể bị bình luận ác ý (d) → Hoa hỏi đã báo giáo viên chưa (a) → Lan trả lời “Not yet” (c).

questions.stem:
Choose the correct arrangement of the sentences to make a meaningful paragraph.
a. If bees disappeared, many plants would not be able to produce fruit and seeds.
b. For example, bees help flowers to reproduce by carrying pollen from one plant to another.
c. As a result, the animals that feed on these plants would also be in danger.
d. Every living thing in an ecosystem plays an important role.
questions.explanation: Câu chủ đề (d) → ví dụ về loài ong (b) → giả định nếu ong biến mất (a) → hệ quả “As a result” (c).

questions.stem:
Read the passage and answer the question.

In the digital age, bullying is no longer limited to the school playground. With the popularity of smartphones and social media, more and more teenagers are becoming victims of cyberbullying. Cyberbullying happens when someone uses digital technology to hurt, threaten or embarrass another person. It can take many forms, such as posting unkind comments, spreading rumours or sharing embarrassing photos online.

Cyberbullying can be even more harmful than traditional bullying. Firstly, it can happen at any time of the day, so victims feel that they cannot escape from it, even at home. Secondly, hurtful messages and photos can spread to a large audience very quickly and may stay online forever. As a result, victims often suffer from stress, low self-esteem and depression. Some of them even stop going to school.

Despite these serious effects, many victims do not tell anyone about the problem. They may feel ashamed, or they may worry that adults will take away their phones.

There are several things teenagers can do to protect themselves. They should never share personal information online and should think carefully before posting anything. If they are bullied, they should not reply to the bully. Instead, they should save the evidence, block the bully and talk to a trusted adult. Schools and parents, for their part, need to create a safe environment where young people feel comfortable asking for help.

Which of the following could be the best title for the passage?
options: Cyberbullying: Its Effects and How to Deal with It
questions.explanation: Bài định nghĩa bắt nạt trên mạng, tác hại và cách đối phó.

questions.stem:
Choose the underlined part that needs correction in the following sentence:
(A) Although the government's efforts, (B) poverty (C) is still a serious problem (D) in some rural areas.
questions.explanation: Sau chỗ sai là cụm danh từ “the government's efforts” → dùng Despite/In spite of thay cho Although.

questions.stem:
Choose the underlined part that needs correction in the following sentence:
Many (A) sea turtles are (B) killed every year because they (C) mistake (D) plastics bag for food.
questions.explanation: Danh từ ghép “plastic bag”: số nhiều thêm “-s” vào danh từ chính → plastic bags.

questions.stem:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given one.
He was very poor, but he managed to finish university.
options: He was very poor, so he managed to finish university.
Despite he was very poor, he managed to finish university.
Because of being very poor, he managed to finish university.
Despite being very poor, he managed to finish university.
questions.explanation: Quan hệ tương phản → Despite + V-ing; “Despite” không đi với mệnh đề; “Because of/so” sai nghĩa.

questions.stem:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given one.
Volunteering helped Mai become more confident.
options: It is volunteering that will help Mai become more confident.
It was volunteering that helped Mai become more confident.
It was volunteering that stopped Mai becoming confident.
It was volunteering what helped Mai become more confident.
questions.explanation: Câu chẻ nhấn mạnh chủ ngữ chỉ việc: It was + volunteering + that + helped…; giữ nguyên thì và nghĩa.
